messages:
Alex: Quick ping — opened a tiny PR to regroup dashboard panels and tidy the tracehook tagging logic. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4621. Would like 1 approval before tomorrow's merge window. Notes: metric rename (latency.p50 -> p50_latency) with a 24h alias migration, and a short test for aliasing.

Priya: thanks — quick q: why rename the metric? will that break our alerts/dashboards?

Alex: Good call. We're moving to the telemetry v2 naming scheme for consistency. PR emits both names for 24h via an alias, and the migration script updates alerts/dashboards in place. See snippet in PR:
```
# migration helper
metrics.alias('latency.p50', 'p50_latency')
```

Sam: can you add a unit test for the aliasing? last time it flaked in CI.

Alex: yep, adding a small test now. also adding a comment in the tracehook about KV-cache key format per our earlier convo.

infra-bot: CI started for PR 4621 — running linux, py39, integration tests.

Marta: also please add a short note in CHANGELOG about the panel regrouping and ping me as a reviewer for the dashboard layout. I can eyeball UX quickly.

Alex: added CHANGELOG entry and tagged Marta for dashboard review. pushed tests and comments. force-pushed.

infra-bot: CI failed on metrics_test.py::test_aliasing — flaky assertion (expected alias present).

Alex: fixing test assertion — my bad on a timing assumption. patching now.

Sam: once tests are stable I can look at the tracehook changes. if you can add a one-line inline comment about why we normalize trace tags that helps.

Alex: done — added inline comment and small sleep in test to avoid race. repushed.

infra-bot: CI passed for PR 4621 (all checks green).

Priya: reviewed metrics/migration files — LGTM from metrics side. :+1:

Marta: dashboard layout looks good to me, minor spacing nit but not blocking. approved. :eyes:

Sam: reviewed tracehook changes; code reads clean, tests cover edge case. approve. :shipit:

Alex: awesome — thanks all. merging into main and kicking off a 10% canary rollout to staging. I'll monitor token-level error rate and latency for the next hour.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for release/2026-03-17 — targets: staging-a (10%).

Alex: monitoring dashboards now. will revert if error rate spikes above 1%. :hand::eyes:
